notes.title: LIVE A LIVE is on sale! Check out a special message from the producer!
notes.notes:
Save 60% on LIVE A LIVE. Experience this legendary RPG, brought alive in the same HD-2D visual style as OCTOPATH TRAVELER.
Offer ends 4 December (6:00 pm UTC)

Takashi Tokita, director of the original and producer of LIVE A LIVE HD-2D REMAKE, has a special message for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877059/bdd79185177b71849007fc8980ab368627b7cbcb.png[/img]
[h3]**About This Game**[/h3]
LIVE A LIVE is an RPG composed of seven individual chapters: Prehistory, Imperial China, The Wild West, Twilight of Edo Japan, Present Day, The Near Future, and The Distant Future. Each chapter features its own protagonist, unique worldview, and distinctive mechanics, allowing players to experience the stories in any order they choose. Furthermore, a new chapter, The Middle Ages, will be unlocked once all seven stories have been completed. In this final chapter, the protagonists from each era will come together to reach a climax that reveals the core of the story.

[h3]**Message for First-Time Players of LIVE A LIVE**[/h3]
If you find it challenging to play RPGs for extended periods, you can still enjoy this game casually by completing one story each day. A demo version is also available, so feel free to try it out at your leisure.
We hope you will enjoy the dramatic stories in each chapter and discover the impactful twists and turns that connect all the chapters!

notes.title: LIVE A LIVE is available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43877059/32de9b15cb3434980b25e405fe16822d2440b6e3.png[/img]

LIVE A LIVE is available now, and is Steam Deck Verified!

Meet 8 heroes, each with their own unique abilities and lives to live across different time periods. Experience their stories and uncover shocking developments along the way!

Featuring remastered music from original composer Yoko Shimomura and produced by Takashi Tokita (the director of the original game), this remake retains everything that players loved about the original while also being accessible to newcomers.

[h3][b]Early Purchase Bonus[/b][/h3]
Customers who purchase during the pre-order period or by 5pm BST / 9am PDT on 11 May 2023 can purchase the game at a 20% discount off the regular price! Don't miss out!

[h3][b]Purchase Bonus[/b][/h3]
You will receive a LIVE A LIVE Legends Wallpaper as a free gift for purchasing the game. Thank you for your support!

[h3][b]LIVE A LIVE: Demo Version[/b][/h3]
A demo version is available with save data transfer enabled through the “Steam Cloud”! Out of the seven chapters, the opening parts of the “Wild West”, “Twilight of Edo Japan”, and “The Distant Future” chapters can be played.
